en: Two-sided vintage postcard. The front side is divided into four black‑and‑white photographs showing city views and religious interiors. The upper left image depicts a large square with the domed former mosque of Pasha Qasim in the center of Pécs. The upper right shows a panoramic view over the city with the four-towered Pécs Cathedral prominent on the skyline. The two lower images show interiors of a church or converted mosque with striped Moorish-style arches, an altar, pews, and religious decorations. The reverse side has Hungarian printed text, handwritten message and address, a green Hungarian postage stamp featuring the castle of Tata and marked "MAGYAR POSTA", plus a circular postmark.
